questionBank.question: Which range should you measure on this 4H chart?
options: The highest and lowest candles on the screen
The external high and low framing the current analysis
questionBank.why: High or low relative to what? The current room.

questionBank.question: Price touches equilibrium. What does that tell you?
options: Where price sits relative to the range
questionBank.why: A reference, not a magic line.

questionBank.question: Price is above the equilibrium of your 4H range. It is…
questionBank.why: Above the middle of the 4H range.

questionBank.question: Price is below 4H equilibrium and above 1H equilibrium. Which is true?
questionBank.why: Both can be true. Different ranges.

questionBank.question: Price is in 4H discount. The 4H is bearish. Buy?
options: No. Discount isn’t a bullish thesis
questionBank.why: Discount told you where. Not what.

questionBank.question: Price is in 4H premium. Does that mean sell?
options: No. Premium is location, not a signal

questionBank.question: Bullish thesis. Price 20,980, objective 21,000. Room left?
questionBank.why: Direction may be right. You might be late.

questionBank.question: Same bullish thesis, price low in the range vs right under the high. Same room?
Bullish 4H, bullish 1H MSS, price in 4H discount. What is it?
Bullish 4H and 1H, but price is extended into upper premium near the objective. What changed?
questionBank.why: Direction can stay bullish while context changes.

questionBank.question: 4H bullish, 4H discount, 1H still strongly bearish with no shift. What now?
options: Wait for the structural story to develop

questionBank.question: 4H unclear, 1H ranging, price near equilibrium. Which thesis do you force?
You built a complete 4H → 1H thesis. Enter?

reflection.heading: YOU CAN BUILD A MARKET THESIS.
reflection.intro:
At the beginning: “I think we’re going up.” Now:
  • ✓ What is the 4H room?
  • ✓ Where are the doors?
  • ✓ Has the range updated?
  • ✓ What is 1H doing inside it?
  • ✓ Which 1H swings matter?
  • ✓ Has structure shifted?
  • ✓ Where is price inside the range?
  • ✓ Premium or discount?
  • ✓ Is there room toward the objective?
  • ✓ What is my primary scenario?
  • ✓ What is my alternate scenario?
  • ✓ What invalidates my thesis?
THAT IS ANALYSIS.
